product.name: Akiflow Time-Blocking Digital Planner & Calendar
product.description: A digital planner that integrates tasks and calendar events into a unified interface with time-blocking capabilities for scheduling and managing daily activities.

product.name: Aki AI Executive Assistant
product.description: An AI-powered assistant integrated into Akiflow that automates task management, scheduling, and workflow routines based on user commands and habits.

product.name: Universal Inbox
product.description: A centralized inbox that automatically imports and consolidates tasks from over 3000 external tools into one unified task list.

product.name: Meeting Booking Assistant
product.description: A scheduling tool that allows users to share available time slots via smart links to facilitate meeting bookings without back-and-forth communication.

product.name: Focus Timer
product.description: A timer tool designed to help users concentrate on tasks by blocking distractions during designated work periods.

product.name: Daily Rituals Assistant
product.description: A feature that assists users in reviewing and planning daily activities to maintain consistent routines and improve productivity.
